انصبنوا (form VII)
# اِنْصَبَنُوا (inṣabanū) /in.sˤa.ba.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْصَبَنَ (inṣabana)
# اِنْصَبِنُوا (inṣabinū) /in.sˤa.bi.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْصَبَنَ (inṣabana)
